title: Size of the DNF circuit
statement: For every natural number $n$ and every Boolean function $f\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\{0,1\}$, the size of the DNF circuit constructed for $f$ is at most $n2^n+2n+1$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean function on $n$ Boolean inputs
